{{Current events|year=2025|month=09|day=3|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****More than 70 [[Palestinians]] are killed by the [[Israeli military]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/3/live-europes-response-on-gaza-a-failure-as-israel-continues-attacks (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Houthis]] launch a [[ballistic missile]] at [[Israel]], which is intercepted. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-intercepts-missile-fired-yemen-2025-09-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[War in the Sahel]]
**[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
***[[Nigeria]]'s [[Nigerian Air Force|air force]] kills more than 15 [[Islamic extremism|Islamist fighters]] in an [[airstrike]] on hideouts in [[Borno State|Borno]]'s [[Sambisa Forest|Sambisa forest]], while troops separately kill 13 [[Boko Haram]] militants after repelling an [[ambush]] on a military convoy along the [[Gubio]]–[[Damasak]] road. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-military-kill-over-28-militia-northeast-borno-state-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
**[[Mali War]]
***[[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin]] spokesman Abou Houfeiza al-Bambari announces a blockade on all fuel trucks that enter Mali. [https://trackingterrorism.org/chatter/jnim-demands-tanker-truck-drivers-that-they-stop-activities-mali-trac/ (TRAC Terrorism)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***[[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]] kill at least 15 [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIS]] fighters and capture key [[militant]] positions, including Ceelasha Burti-Cise and Af-ka Dharimood in the [[Balade (Somalia)|Baallade Valley]], following a series of intense military operations in the broader [[Cal Miskaad]] Mountains of the [[Bari, Somalia|Bari region]], [[Puntland]]. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202509030390.html (AllAfrica)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]] fires more than 500 [[drone warfare|drones]] and two dozen missiles at [[Ukraine]] overnight, targeting mostly western and central Ukraine and wounding at least five people, in response to the attacks, [[Poland]] scrambles its [[fighter jet]]s and places ground-based [[air defense]]s and radar systems on maximum readiness. [https://www.newsweek.com/poland-nato-fighter-jets-scramble-ukraine-russia-attack-drones-2123682 (''Newsweek'')] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-trump-zelenskyy-putin-9d6b9bf76a15971c17ae2de9ca1211b5 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Nazi]]-[[Nazi plunder|looted]] painting ''[[Portrait of a Lady (Contessa Colleoni)|Portrait of a Lady]]'' by [[Giuseppe Vittore Ghislandi]] is handed over to the [[Judiciary of Argentina|Argentine justice system]] after being discovered on display in a private house in [[Mar del Plata]], [[Argentina]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2581085-door-nazi-s-geroofd-schilderij-terecht-argentijnse-dochter-van-nazi-levert-het-in (NOS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States–India diplomatic and trade crisis]], [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[India]] approves cutting [[Taxation in India|taxes]] on hundreds of consumer goods in response to new [[U.S.]] [[tariff]]s imposed on India last month. The overhaul cuts the [[consumption tax]] from a four-tier structure to a two-[[Tax rate|rate]] structure. [https://apnews.com/article/india-goods-services-tax-us-tariff-9538843a2bde3124004273756b26db6b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Punjab, India floods]]
**At least 30 people are killed in [[flash flood]]s caused by [[cloudburst]]s, [[landslide]]s, and [[Waterlogging (agriculture)|waterlogging]] across [[north India]], including in [[Punjab, India|Punjab]], [[Odisha]], and [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. Casualty numbers are expected to increase. [https://www.dw.com/en/rains-wreak-havoc-in-northern-india/a-73863094 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/heavy-rain-lashes-northern-india-yamuna-river-breaches-danger-mark-delhi-2025-09-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ascensor da Glória derailment]]
**Sixteen people are killed and 22 others are injured when the ''[[Ascensor da Glória]]'' [[funicular]] crashes into a building in [[Lisbon]], [[Portugal]]. The [[Portuguese government]] declares a [[day of mourning]] for the following day in remembrance of those deceased. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugal-investigates-crash-historic-lisbon-funicular-that-killed-16-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1jzlgj915no (BBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/09/04/nx-s1-5528599/portugal-streetcar-accident-deadly-mourning (NPR)]
*Seven migrants are found dead on beaches after several boats from [[Algeria]] sink off the coast of [[Andalusia]], [[Spain]], as authorities rescue 26 people from one vessel and 38 from another and continue searching for additional victims. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1939542/seven-migrants-found-dead-on-spanish-beaches (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
*One person is killed, another is injured, and five others are reported missing during an accident on a [[Hanwha Ocean]] [[floating production storage and offloading]] ship at a shipyard in [[South Korea]]. [https://www.upstreamonline.com/safety/petrobras-official-rushed-to-hospital-after-fall-from-fpso-being-built-at-hanwha-ocean/2-1-1866254 (''Upstream'')]
*A rescue team locates the burnt remains of the [[EastIndo]] passenger [[MBB/Kawasaki BK 117]] helicopter that went missing on Monday in [[Kalimantan]], [[Indonesia]], on the island of [[Borneo]] and recovers one body. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-borneo-helicopter-crash-site-4b8a4c580416190d14e6e7e5ccca05ab (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 China Victory Day Parade]]
**[[China]] holds a [[military parade]] in [[Beijing]] to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the [[End of World War II in Asia|end of World War II]]. The event is attended by the leaders of about two dozen countries. [https://apnews.com/article/china-military-parade-world-war-xi-jinping-ed1f7b3e245882dd91b597df24eafbea (AP)]
*[[Czech Republic–Germany relations]]
**[[Czech Republic|Czech]] [[Ministry of Defence (Czech Republic)|defence minister]] [[Jana Černochová]] announces that the [[Czech government]] signed a deal to pay [[Czech koruna|Kč]]34 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]1.6 billion) for 44 [[Leopard 2A8]] tanks from [[Germany]] as part of its efforts to modernize the [[Czech Armed Forces|Armed Forces]]. [https://apnews.com/article/czech-germany-leopard-tanks-defense-military-modernization-f3ed86b998653a82d01f04cdf8dfc2ed (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Odebrecht case]]
**A [[Peru]]vian [[Judiciary of Peru|court]] sentences former [[President of Peru|president]] [[Alejandro Toledo]] to 13 years and four months in prison for [[Money laundering|laundering]] [[Peruvian sol|S/]]18 million (US$5.1 million) in [[Bribery|bribes]] from [[Brazil]]ian construction company [[Odebrecht]] through [[offshore account]]s to purchase and refinance properties in [[Lima]], with the sentence to run concurrently with his earlier conviction for accepting S/124 million ($35 million) in [[Kickback (finance)|kickbacks]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peruvian-court-hands-ex-president-toledo-second-corruption-sentence-2025-09-03/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and the perpetrator is injured in a [[mass stabbing]] in a pizza restaurant in [[Gwanak District]], [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2025/09/03/asia-pacific/crime-legal/stabbing-seoul-pizza-restaurant/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*A [[Morocco|Moroccan]] [[Judiciary of Morocco|court]] sentences [[Human rights in Morocco|human rights]] activist [[Ibtissame Lachgar]] to 30 months in prison and a fine of [[Moroccan dirham|DH]]50,000 (US$5,510) for [[Islam and blasphemy|blasphemy]], with her lawyers stating they will appeal. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250903-moroccan-feminist-sentenced-to-30-months-for-blasphemy-due-to-t-shirt-slogan (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Jamaican general election]]
**[[Jamaicans]] vote to elect the 63 members of the [[Parliament of Jamaica|Parliament]] using [[first-past-the-post voting]]. The two leading parties are the ruling [[Jamaica Labour Party]] and the opposition [[People's National Party]]. [https://www.caribbeanlife.com/inside-life-jamaican-elections-2025/ (Caribbean Life)]
*[[2025 Saint Helena general election]]
**Residents of [[Saint Helena]], a [[British Overseas Territory]], vote for the twelve members of the [[Legislative Council of Saint Helena|Legislative Council]] using [[plurality block voting]]. [https://en.mercopress.com/2025/05/14/st-helena-general-election-scheduled-for-03-september-2025-12-legco-seats-at-stake (MercoPress)]
*[[2025 Thai political crisis]], [[2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis]]
**The ruling [[Pheu Thai Party]] of the [[Government of Thailand|acting government]] of [[Thailand]] moves to dissolve the [[Parliament of Thailand|parliament]], setting up for [[Next Thai general election|a new election]], after [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Paetongtarn Shinawatra]] was dismissed from office due to her [[Thailand–Cambodia phone call leak|phone call leak with Cambodia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/thailand-ruling-party-moves-to-dissolve-parliament/a-73860361 (DW)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Composition of Mars]]
**Scientists report that [[Mars]] has a solid inner [[planetary core|core]] of iron and nickel about 613 kilometers in radius, surrounded by a liquid outer core, based on seismic data from [[NASA]]'s [[InSight]] [[Lander (spacecraft)|lander]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mars-core-nasa-insight-ac38ae787b41d3d2727a693f3c2b7d28 (AP)]
